training_issue_found.description: G001 curriculum advanced from full_1v1 to full_2v2 after generation 74.

g002_reasoning: Preserve kickoff ability without letting kickoff dominate the entire curriculum.
Increase exposure to scripted and specialist opponents because passing/counterpress/solo-duel were still difficult.
Train neutral central duels and pressure escapes to address original_1v1 and passing_1v1 failures.
Train finishing quality because worker_3 produced high shot volume but scored zero goals in both original_1v1 benchmark matches.
Use a slightly tighter mutation/search range to refine the verified champion rather than restart broad exploration.
